g.data-label: M8 L0 Semantic Cache Has this question been answered before?
M9 Pareto Cost Router Pick the cheapest model that is smart enough
🔵 L1: Free Local Model (Llama-3 on company computer)
🟡 L2: Medium Fast Cloud (Llama-70B on NVIDIA NIM)
🔴 L3: Frontier Supercomputer (GPT-4o or Claude-3.5)
M10 Execution Waterfall Send prompt to chosen model
Did Provider Fail? (Rate limit or outage?)
Cascade to Backup Provider (Groq / Secondary / Local)
M11 Verification & Reflection Check facts against company docs
M14 Observability Ledger Record dollars saved vs GPT-4o
🎉 Final Response to User (Fast, Accurate, Secure & Cheap!)
